⚙️ Game

🧠 DFR World Brain

The World Brain is the narrative intelligence for this campaign. DFR owns canon, memory, relationships, world state and player control; the local language model generates the moment-to-moment story and NPC behaviour.

World Brain architecture v1 — local model required for generated narrative.

0%

Local AI is off — no generated narrative will be requested.

Mature themes: enabled for the story system. Passionate/romantic scenes can be written as part of the narrative; local AI is optional. The engine still preserves and validates campaign state offline.

🎭 Scenarios, worlds & saves

Each scenario is its own campaign. You can build worlds and characters with ChatGPT, export them as JSON, then import them here. Imported content becomes the campaign's canon; anything you leave open can be expanded naturally by the world/story AI.

🧩 Scenario import format
A scenario can define only the pieces you care about: premise, world, lore, tone, factions, locations, rules, secrets and story threads. Empty or missing sections stay open for the generator to develop instead of forcing random filler.
🎲 Random world generator
Random campaigns are still available, but imported scenarios take priority over randomness. The generator should expand missing details around your supplied ideas rather than overwrite them.
🧠 Continuity memory

These are the facts the story system is allowed to carry forward. Private knowledge stays with the character who learned it.

Save management

Story controls

Deleting a scenario only removes that campaign from this device.
